name: OpenCode
description: Indexes local OpenCode sessions from the on-device SQLite database as searchable markdown documents.

fields.title: OpenCode data directory
fields.description: Folder containing opencode.db. Leave empty to auto-detect (%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\opencode).

fields.title: Include tool calls
fields.description: Include one-line tool call summaries. Tool outputs are never indexed.

fields.title: Include archived sessions
fields.description: Also index sessions that are archived in OpenCode.
